capabilities: Adds sticky notes, borderless text and seven shapes to canvases
Draws freehand marker lines in five colors with an eraser
Arranges copies and layers with shortcuts and a right-click menu
Navigates boards with a minimap, zoom buttons and snap-to-grid
extras: Desktop only (Windows, macOS, Linux). No network requests, accounts or telemetry; images picked from the computer are copied into the vault. Boards stay plain .canvas JSON with a few added fields, so scripts and AI agents can draw on them.
intentEvidence: Sticky notes, shapes, a freehand marker, frames, layers and a minimap on top of the core Canvas.
problem: Obsidian's core Canvas has no whiteboard tools: no sticky notes, shapes, freehand drawing, frames, layers or minimap.

relations.evidence: Install Advanced Canvas first. Cult Canvas is built on it.
Bend points on arrows, as in Miro

summary: Whiteboard layer for Obsidian Canvas that adds sticky notes, shapes, a freehand marker, frames, layers and a minimap on top of Advanced Canvas.
